---
title: "`ring_plot()` — standalone enrichment ring"
---

## Purpose

Draw the enrichment ring on its own — top-N pathways as arc segments, with no
volcano at the centre. Useful when the pathway result is the whole story.

## When to use

When you want a ring without a volcano: as a small multiple, a standalone
supplementary panel, or to compose with a separate volcano via `ev_compose()`.

## How it works

Subsets the enrichment result to `contrast` (and to `dedup_kept` rows when that
column is present from `ev_collapse()`), orders by `order_by` / `order_dir`, and
keeps the top `max_terms`. Each pathway becomes an arc with
`ggforce::geom_arc_bar()`: arc thickness encodes `magnitude`
(`neg_log_padj` / `nes` / `gene_count`) and fill encodes `color`
(`nes` / `neg_log_padj` / `direction`) on the diverging palette. With
`split_by_direction = TRUE`, up-NES terms fill the top half and down-NES the
bottom half. Pathway names are cleaned by `label_clean_fn` if supplied, else the
built-in cleaner. If no pathways survive, it returns a "No significant pathways"
placeholder.

::: {.callout-important}
`max_terms` defaults to **10** for legibility. The function **warns** above 12
(labels may collide) and **aborts** above 25 — past that the arcs are illegible.
:::

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `max_terms` | `10` | legible ring; warn >12, abort >25 |
| `order_by` | `"padj"` | most significant terms first |
| `order_dir` | `"asc"` | ascending (smallest padj first) |
| `magnitude` | `"neg_log_padj"` | arc thickness = significance |
| `color` | `"nes"` | arc fill = directional NES |
| `split_by_direction` | `TRUE` | up terms top half, down terms bottom half |
| `label_clean_fn` | `NULL` | falls back to the built-in label cleaner |
| `theme` | `ev_theme()` | locked palette + theme |

## Literature

No method-specific citation; see [methods](../methods.qmd).

## Example

```r
e <- ev_enrich(dep, contrast = "CTLvMITO", databases = "hallmark", species = "rat")
ring_plot(e, contrast = "CTLvMITO",
          max_terms = 8, magnitude = "nes", color = "neg_log_padj")
```
